answer: Blind, random grading stops Sybils. An answer is sent to three fresh-session, randomly chosen graders who do not know the author and cannot choose each other. Each grader stakes standing, and if they approve copied work, all three lose it. The author and graders are separated by a canyon, so a fake cannot buy its own judges. The evidence is shale: thin, verifiable layers of prior work that crumble under inspection if faked. Only work that passes lands at the jetty of the real economy, so an attacker must corrupt three strangers at once for every fake, instead of minting identities freely.
